intro: Turn every meal into an experience with Marcelli chairs. A tall cushioned backrest, and sturdy frame keep you comfortable while adding timeless style to your dining space.

features.title: Cushioned comfort you can feel
features.text: Soft polyester fabric and high-density foam give you lasting comfort, so dinners and conversations stretch longer without discomfort.

features.title: Tall backrest for posture support
features.text: An angular cushioned backrest supports your spine, helping you sit comfortably whether it’s a quick breakfast or a long family gathering.

features.title: Strong solid rubberwood frame
features.text: Crafted with durable rubberwood, the walnut-finished frame brings strength, reliability, and warmth to your dining setup.

features.title: Waterfall edge for added ease
features.text: A waterfall-style seat edge reduces pressure on your legs, so you remain relaxed and supported through extended seating.

features.title: Subtle detailing with finesse
features.text: Unique design touches give the chairs a refined look, blending seamlessly with the Marcelli dining table or other setups.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
